TA_b_per_rx.rule: dropped > 0 on EVERY RX thread and sum(RX dropped) == stats.log Total kernel_drops

TA_c_residual.formula: capture.kernel_packets - capture.kernel_drops - decoder.pkts (last stats.log record, Total rows)
TA_c_residual.scope_note: SCIENTIFIC_VALIDITY 6(c) states no scope; ROOT_CAUSE section 5 states 'in every run with drops'. The evaluator applies the drop-run scope and REPORTS non-drop runs separately (scope = decision point D-TA-1).
